title: Breaking Into Existing Services Permit
name: Breaking Into Existing Services Permit
description: Controls opening, cutting, disconnecting or modifying existing pipework, ductwork or services after identification, isolation, depressurisation and safe drain-down.

sections.title: SERVICE IDENTIFICATION AND ISOLATION
items: The correct service and break-in point have been positively identified
Current drawings / labels / tracing information have been checked
All relevant energy, pressure, temperature and hazardous contents have been considered
Isolation points are identified and secured against inadvertent operation
The service is drained, vented, purged or depressurised as required
The zero-energy / safe condition has been verified before opening

fields.label: Isolation Points / Locks / Tags / Valve Details
Drain / Vent / Purge / Pressure / Safe-state Verification

sections.title: BREAK-IN CONTROLS
items: Suitable PPE / RPE is selected for residual contents
Containment is available for liquid, sludge or contamination
Nearby people and equipment are protected
Correct tools and controlled cutting methods are selected
Emergency arrangements cover unexpected release or wrong-service identification
Work stops if contents, pressure, temperature or service identity differ from expectation

sections.title: REINSTATEMENT
items: The service has been reconnected / capped / left in a defined safe state
Joints / fittings are checked before re-pressurisation
Guards, insulation and labels are restored as required
The affected system is tested or recommissioned under the correct control
Area is clean and residual materials are removed
